verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official first-party MCP server letting MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code) build and manage Retell voice agents via Retell APIs, with specific capabilities like agent create/update/publish/list. This is a genuine server-mode MCP offering, not just client integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented, and detail on full tool coverage beyond agent management.
